tokens.title: Token Rules & Mechanics
tokens.summary: Luxora uses service tokens to represent your service entitlements. 1 token = 1 complete doorstep service.
rules: Tokens are credited instantly upon subscription or monthly renewal.
1 token is consumed automatically when one service is completed to your satisfaction.
Unused tokens rollover for active subscribers up to your tier's maximum accumulation cap.

cancellation.title: Cancellation & Rescheduling Policy
cancellation.summary: Bookings can be rescheduled or cancelled free of charge up to 6 hours before your scheduled appointment window.
rules: Free cancellation / reschedule: At least 6 hours before the start of the scheduled window.
Late cancellation (< 6 hours): Forfeits 1 service token to compensate the allocated provider.
How to reschedule: Go to My Bookings > Select Appointment > Click Reschedule/Cancel.

no_show.title: Provider Lateness & No-Show Guarantee
no_show.summary: Luxora guarantees on-time doorstep arrival. If your provider is delayed by over 30 minutes without prior communication, you receive priority resolution.
rules: Over 30 minutes late with no notification: You are entitled to immediate supervisor intervention.
No-Show outcome: 100% token refund + priority rescheduling with an apology service credit.
How to report: Inform the AI Concierge or click 'Report No-Show' directly from your booking card.

requested_service.title: Requested Services Policy
requested_service.summary: A Requested Service is a bespoke or oversized job outside standard package tier limits.
rules: Gardens over 30 perches require a Requested Service quote.
Specialized automotive detailing (ceramic coating, paint correction, engine steam cleaning) is handled via Requested Services.
Bespoke pet styling, show grooming, or estate multi-service projects qualify as Requested Services.
Our operations management team assesses submissions within 2–4 business hours and prepares a custom token/pricing quote.

renewal_subscription.title: Subscriptions & Billing
renewal_subscription.summary: Subscriptions run on a 30-day recurring cycle with automated token crediting.
rules: Billing: Automated on your monthly anniversary date via stored card or corporate invoice.
Change tiers: You can upgrade or downgrade anytime; changes take effect on the next billing cycle.
Cancellation: You can cancel auto-renewal in Account Settings at any time with no lock-in contract.
